wildcard_exceptions.justification: In a KMS key policy, Resource "*" refers to the key the policy is attached to; no other resource can be named.

tf-deploy creates resources whose ARNs do not exist before apply, so it needs service-level actions. Blast radius is capped by the eu-central-1/eu-west-3/us-east-1 region condition, IAM scoped to hestia-* names, the mandatory permissions boundary on new roles, explicit audit/CI-identity denies, and the org SCPs (ADR-004, ADR-007).

A VPC endpoint policy cannot enumerate buckets created later; aws:ResourceAccount restricts it to this account's buckets, which is the anti-exfiltration control. IAM and bucket policies still decide who may do what.

AutoScaling and EC2 Describe*/GetInstanceTypesFromInstanceRequirements calls do not support resource-level permissions; AWS requires Resource "*". They are read-only; the mutating statement is scoped to ASGs tagged k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/<cluster>=owned.
cloudwatch:PutMetricData does not support resource-level permissions; AWS requires Resource "*". The cloudwatch:namespace condition limits it to Hestia/Carbon (ADR-008).
